newProjects.description: Fully local MCP retrieval tool for coding agents. 161M encoder, ~1s per tool call, no API, no LLM in the query path. No file reads: line numbers, callers, callees and exact call sites, packed to a token budget. 2-4x the file coverage of BM25 and TF-IDF on SWE-Explore, and tops the paper's own sub-1B code model on CORE-Bench.
